documents.title: Press Release - CPCL Financial Performance For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30.09.2026

analysis.summary: Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited (CPCL) reported a record crude throughput of 11.71 MMT for FY 2025-26, operating at 112% of installed capacity. The company achieved a full-year Gross Refining Margin (GRM) of $9.2 per barrel and a Q4 GRM of $13.75 per barrel, surpassing the Singapore benchmark figures. Management announced a total dividend of INR 62 per share for the year, comprising an interim dividend of INR 8 and a recommended final dividend of INR 54 per share. CPCL is progressing with major capital expenditure projects, including an INR 1,600 crore Group 2 and Group 3 LOBS project and an INR 400 crore retail outlet expansion. Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited (CPCL) reported its Q4 FY25 financial and operational results, achieving a full-year crude throughput of 10.45 MMT, representing a 99.5% capacity utilization.

guidance.claim: CPCL expects commissioning from its 300 retail outlet licenses during FY27.
guidance.quote: Even our retail outlet endeavor for which we had taken 300 licenses has started. And this year, that is '26-'27, we'll see a lot of commissioning out of them.

guidance.claim: CPCL expects maintenance CAPEX for next year to remain in the Rs. 200-250 crore range.
guidance.quote: Our maintenance CAPEX remains Rs. 200-250 crore range, and the next year forecast also, we feel the CAPEX will be in that range.

guidance.claim: Normal maintenance CAPEX for the next two years is expected to be around Rs. 250 to Rs. 300 crores per year.
guidance.quote: The normal maintenance CAPEX for the next two years would be around Rs. 250 to Rs. 300 crores, maintenance CAPEX plus small regular CAPEX normally.

demand_outlook.claim: CPCL's net GRM based on realized refinery transfer price is close to its long-term average.
demand_outlook.quote: The net GRM based on realized RTP is pretty close to the long-term average.

demand_outlook.claim: There is a shortfall of Motor Spirit (MS) in the southern market of approximately 20 TMT per month.
demand_outlook.quote: MS in southern market, there is a clear shortfall so, the production is less than demand. It is close to about 20 TMT per month.

demand_outlook.claim: MS demand growth in the southern market is estimated at 4%-5% compared to the national projection of 6%.
demand_outlook.quote: As far as others are concerned, we have seen the southern market to be mostly aligned to the national growth projection. Like MS, they are projecting 6% and here we see around 4%-5%.

demand_outlook.claim: HSD growth in the southern market is forecasted at 3%.
demand_outlook.quote: HSD we see at 3% growth forecast, as against 2.5% odd here.

capex_expansion.claim: CPCL incurred a capex of INR 856 crores in FY26 compared to INR 673 crores in the previous year.
capex_expansion.quote: During the current year, the capex was INR856 crores as compared to INR673 crores in the previous year.

capex_expansion.claim: Project execution for the Group 2 and Group 3 LOBS project has started in full swing following all approvals.
capex_expansion.quote: Some of the important projects that we'll be taking up is Group 2, Group 3 LOBS for which all approvals are in place and the project execution has started in full swing.

capex_expansion.claim: CPCL expects normal annual maintenance capex to be approximately INR 500 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Besides, every year, you can assume another INR500 crores is our normal capex.

capex_expansion.claim: The new Group 2 and Group 3 LOBS unit will add 250 KTPA of fresh capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: My new unit will take me to a 250,000, 250 KTPA in Group 2, Group 3 capacity, and that will be a fresh addition.

capex_expansion.claim: CPCL spent Rs. 673 crores as CAPEX during FY 2024-25.
capex_expansion.quote: On the CAPEX front, in the current year, we have spent Rs. 673 crores as CAPEX for the current year.

capex_expansion.claim: The revised capital cost for the Cauvery Basin Refinery project is Rs. 36,354 crores with a 25:75 equity holding between CPCL and Indian Oil.
capex_expansion.quote: The revised capital cost is at Rs. 36,354 crores with a 25:75 equity holding between CPCL and Indian oil respectively.

margins_costs.claim: The gross refining margin for Q4 FY26 was $13.75 per barrel compared to the Singapore benchmark of $8.70 per barrel.
margins_costs.quote: The GRM for quarter 4 was $13.75 barrel as compared to Singapore benchmark of $8.70 per barrel, which again reiterates that all these efficiencies are constant, continuous and are being sustained over each period.

margins_costs.claim: Core GRM for Q4 FY26 was $10.3 per barrel.
Forex loss was approximately INR 200 crores for Q4 FY26 and around INR 350 crores for the full year.
margins_costs.quote: For the quarter, it would be for the quarter, it is approximately INR 200 crores,. And for the whole year, it will be around INR350 crores.

margins_costs.claim: CPCL processed 52% high sulphur crude during FY26.
margins_costs.quote: During the financial year, we processed 52% high sulphur.

margins_costs.claim: CPCL recorded a full-year GRM of $4.22 per barrel for FY 2024-25 compared to $8.64 per barrel in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: The GRM for 2024-25 for a full year basis is $4.22 per barrel as compared to the previous year $8.64 per barrel, but if you compare it to Singapore benchmark which was $3.79 per barrel in the current year, we have performed better.

margins_costs.claim: Q4 FY25 GRM was $6.22 per barrel compared to the Singapore benchmark of $3.1 per barrel.
margins_costs.quote: On Quarter 4, our GRM was $6.22 per barrel. Again, if I compare the previous year same quarter, it was $7.7 per barrel, but if I compare it to Singapore benchmark, which was only $3.1 per barrel.

margins_costs.claim: Inventory gain for Q4 FY25 was $0.66 per barrel or Rs. 125 crores.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, the inventory gain is not very significant for the quarter. It is only $ 0.66 per barrel. And in absolute rupee terms, it is Rs. 125 crores only.

margins_costs.claim: Fuel and loss for the year came down to 8.51%.
margins_costs.quote: and in that context, the fuel and loss has come down to 8.51% for the year as a whole.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported a core GRM of $3.75/bbl for the first nine months of FY 2024-25.

orders_capacity.claim: CPCL achieved a record crude throughput of 11.71 MMT in FY26, equivalent to 112% of installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: CPCL achieved a highest ever crude throughput of 11.71 MMT, million metric ton, which equivalents to 112% of installed capacity, breaking records of our previous best of 11.64 MMT achieved in financial year 2023-'24.

orders_capacity.claim: CPCL achieved a record distillate yield of 79.1% during FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Further, highest ever distillate yield of 79.1%, beating our previous record of 77.6% set in 2019-'20 was also achieved during this year.

orders_capacity.claim: Production reached record annual levels of 5.139 MMT for diesel and 1.318 MMT for petrol in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: CPCL concluded the financial year on a high note, achieving the highest ever production levels of 5.139 MMT for diesel HSD, and 1.318 MMT of petrol that is MS, an impressive testament of the refinery's outstanding operational performance.

orders_capacity.claim: CPCL achieved a record LPG production of 447 TMT in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: CPCL achieved highest ever LPG production of 447 TMT, overcoming previous record of 404 set in 2023-'24.

orders_capacity.claim: Long-term crude sourcing remains at around 55% to 60%.
orders_capacity.quote: Our long-term sourcing remains at around 55% - 60% and the remaining through spot and the opportunity crudes depending on individual economics, and we try to harness and increase them to keep profitability at the best.

orders_capacity.claim: The Manali refinery has an installed capacity of 10.5 MMTPA.

capital_allocation.claim: Gross debt to equity ratio decreased to 0.18 from 0.39 in the previous year.
capital_allocation.quote: Our debt equity stands at 0.18 at a gross level as compared to 0.39 last year.

capital_allocation.claim: Gross borrowings stand at INR 1,900 crores and net borrowings stand at INR 973 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: On a gross basis, the borrowings are INR1,900 crores, but on a net basis, it is less than INR1,000 crores, to be precise, INR973 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a final dividend of INR 54 per share in addition to the interim dividend of INR 8 per share, bringing the total dividend to INR 62 per share for FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year, for the first time, CPCL paid an interim dividend, and we are happy to announce that in addition to the interim dividend of INR8 per equity share of INR10 each, the Board has recommended a final dividend of INR54 per share, taking the total dividend for the year to INR62 per share, which again is highest ever.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a dividend of Rs. 5 per equity share for FY 2024-25.
capital_allocation.quote: With the above, the Board has also recommended a dividend of Rs. 5 per equity share that is 50% of face value for the current year and as we all know, this is subject to approval at AGM, which will happen in the due course.

capital_allocation.claim: Absolute debt stood at Rs. 3,100 crores as on March 31, 2025 compared to Rs. 2,762 crores as on March 31, 2024.
capital_allocation.quote: At an absolute level, the debt stands at Rs. 3,100 crores as compared to Rs. 2,762 crores as on March 31, 2024.

capital_allocation.claim: The debt-to-equity ratio as of March 31, 2025 was 0.39 compared to 0.32 in the prior year.
capital_allocation.quote: When I turn to leverage position, the debt equity position as on March 31, 2025, is 0.39 compared to 0.32 in the previous year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Around 30% to 40% of Middle East long-term crude supply was affected over a short period due to market disturbances.
risks_headwinds.quote: What has impacted is that maybe 30% to 40% was affected over a very short period, but all have assured us that depending on the situation, they will make up all the cargoes.

risks_headwinds.claim: CPCL has scheduled maintenance and inspection for one of its refinery units close to September or October.
risks_headwinds.quote: But yes, maybe close to September, October, we have a scheduled M&I of one of our refinery units.

risks_headwinds.claim: Uncertainties from volatile crude prices present operational and earnings challenges.
risks_headwinds.quote: Finally, the uncertainties due to volatility of crude prices do pose a challenge.

risks_headwinds.claim: International product cracks declined compared to the prior year.
risks_headwinds.quote: We all know that product cracks have reduced as compared to previous year in the international market, but our endeavor to better the benchmark continues.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company reported a loss of Rs 374 crore for the first nine months of FY 2024-25.

management_commitments.claim: CPCL will see a lot of commissioning from its 300 retail outlet licenses during FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Even our retail outlet endeavor for which we had taken 300 licenses has started. And this year, that is '26-'27, we'll see a lot of commissioning out of them.

management_commitments.claim: CPCL projects normal maintenance CAPEX to be around Rs. 250 to Rs. 300 crores annually for the next two years.
management_commitments.quote: The normal maintenance CAPEX for the next two years would be around Rs. 250 to Rs. 300 crores, maintenance CAPEX plus small regular CAPEX normally.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
